Moduli spaces and related topics in algebraic geometry
Description:Topics in algebraic stacks and how it relates to K-stability and other moduli notions. We plan to focus on topics including, but not limited to, foliations, algebraic stacks, K-stability and K-moduli, moduli theories and birational geometry. We plan for this seminar to be a supplement to the usual weekly algebraic geometry seminar, covering a broad range of topics in moduli theories...
